title: Gains on non-benefited deposits: interest income, up to 25%

source.title: Tax Authority guide 2025, p.40, section "ד. ריבית ורווחים מקרן השתלמות (סעיף 15)"; p.87 (row 9(13)); Ordinance ss.3(e4)(1), 125C(b)

rate.notes: Gains accrued from 1.1.2003 on deposits above the ceiling, withdrawn after the holding period: maximum rate "שלא יעלה על 25%" (s.125C(b), top slice of income); the fund withholds 25%. The rule base does NOT say the base is the real gain: real vs nominal base, the treatment of the linkage part, and whether 15% (s.125C(c)) can ever apply are unsettled (open question 1; guide p.87 says the s.9(13) linkage exemption does not apply to a provident fund account). Strength is primary (the Tax Authority guide), not institution.

source.title: Mor, "תקרת הפקדה לקרן השתלמות"; also Clal, "מהי תקרת ההפקדה לקרן השתלמות?" (https://www.clalbit.co.il/educationfund/faq/educationfundmax/)

real_base.notes: Base of the 25%: the real gain. The Tax Authority guide gives no base (tax-hishtalmut.md open question 1); two managers state the real gain (browser pass 3, 2026-10-22). Institution strength: computes with a label (coverage F1, method G-04).
